name: Scenario AS: Patient Intake
comments: Triggered by a Freshchat conversation.created webhook. Keyword filter detects healthcare intake terms (appointment, new patient, insurance, referral, prescription). Claude drives a Freshchat conversation to collect patient name, DOB, and insurance carrier. Creates a HubSpot contact with intake data. Sends intake summary to clinic admin via Resend. Sends confirmation email with next steps to the patient via Resend. Error route sends an internal alert. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. HIPAA note: no PHI is stored in Make.com — all data passes through to HubSpot and Resend only. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Fires on conversation.created. Case-insensitive regex filter passes healthcare intake keywords. Register Make webhook URL in Freshchat Admin > Settings > Webhooks > Conversation Created.
Claude extracts available intake fields from the initial message. Missing fields will be followed up in the Freshchat conversation message (module 4).

RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT.label: Resend Client From Address
RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT.notes: Verified clinic domain sender. Never brian@cwiai.net.

notes.label: Module 1 — Freshchat Webhook + Healthcare Filter
notes.note: Fires on conversation.created. Case-insensitive regex: appointment|new patient|insurance|referral|prescription.

notes.label: Modules 2–3 — Claude: Extract Intake Fields
notes.note: Claude extracts patient_name, dob, insurance_carrier, reason_for_visit, is_new_patient from the first message. Missing fields are null. ParseJSON (module 3) structures the result.

notes.label: Modules 4–5 — AI Freshchat Conversation
notes.note: Claude (module 4) generates an intelligent response: confirms collected fields and asks for missing ones, or wraps up if complete. Posted to Freshchat in module 5.

notes.label: Module 6 — HubSpot Contact Creation
notes.note: Creates or updates a HubSpot contact with all intake fields. confidential:true set in scenario metadata as this handles patient data.

notes.label: Modules 7–8 — Admin Summary + Patient Confirmation
notes.note: Module 7 emails full intake summary to clinic admin. Module 8 sends a patient confirmation with next steps from the clinic domain (RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT). No PHI echoed back in the patient email beyond what they sent.
